rationale: Basement flooding from a burst plumbing supply line within the policyholder's own home causing damage to the structure (hardwood flooring, drywall) and contents (boxes), not involving third-party property or injury.
claim_summary: Policyholder returned from a work trip to find basement flooded with approximately two inches of water caused by a burst supply line under an upstairs bathroom sink that ran for two days. Damage includes buckled hardwood flooring, drywall soaked to one foot, and ruined stored boxes. This is a high-severity claim requiring immediate assessment and mitigation.

case_facts.description: two inches of water across whole basement, hardwood floor buckled, drywall soaked to one foot high, stored boxes ruined
case_facts.estimated_damage: appears significant - flooring, drywall, and contents damaged
case_facts.incident_cause: burst supply line under upstairs bathroom sink, ran for approximately two days
